visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with short black hair and glasses, wearing a black tank top, stands inside a Costco warehouse. He is looking down into a red metal shopping cart where the camera is positioned, creating a wide-angle perspective of the high industrial ceiling and warehouse shelves. (2) The man holds up a three-pack box of Febreze fabric refresher, showing the Japanese and Chinese text on the yellow and blue packaging. He gives a thumbs-up gesture while smiling brightly at the lens. (3) In an indoor bedroom setting with soft warm lighting, the man sprays the Febreze bottle onto a heavy white and black winter jacket hanging on a wooden door. He then moves to spray a bed with a light teal duvet. (4) The scene shifts to a restaurant where several people are seated around a steaming hotpot. The man is seen eating. The camera then cuts to him inside a car interior, looking uncomfortable and holding his nose. (5) Back at a home entrance, the man sprays his own body with the gold-colored spray bottle. A close-up shows a brown tabby cat meowing while being pet by a hand. (6) In a living room with a cat tree, a young boy in dinosaur pajamas uses the spray bottle on a small brown rug. The man is then seen sitting on an office chair with a visual overlay of white smoke swirling around him. (7) An outdoor shot shows heavy rain falling over a green, hilly landscape. The man is shown back indoors spraying a grey mattress and pillows. (8) The boy is seen again spraying a cat litter box area on a balcony-like space. Finally, the man is back in the Costco warehouse with a cart full of the product boxes, smiling and waving them towards the camera.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a high-arousal male voice speaking in a mix of Mandarin and Taiwanese Hokkien. The speech rate is fast and enthusiastic. A bright, upbeat electronic pop BGM with a steady 124 BPM beat starts immediately. (2) A sharp 'shh-shh' sound effect of a liquid spray bottle triggers as the narrator describes the product's function. The music remains consistent with heavy synthesized percussion. (3) A 'whoosh' transition sound occurs as the visual scene shifts. Muffled background chatter and the faint clink of dishes are audible during the restaurant scene, though the primary narration remains dominant and clear. (4) A digital 'ding' bell sound effect highlights a specific product benefit. The vocal pitch rises for emphasis. The BGM remains in a major key with a positive, energetic vibe. (5) The spraying SFX repeats during the helmet and pet scenes. The narrator's tone shifts to a slightly more rhythmic, almost melodic delivery, synchronized with the upbeat tempo of the background track. (6) The final phase features a crescendo in the narrator's volume for the call to action, followed by a crisp hard cut where both the vocals and the music terminate simultaneously.
